# Halcyon Pain Management Centre

> Halcyon Pain Management Centre in Kukatpally, Hyderabad treats knee, back, neck, shoulder, nerve and sports pain without surgery. The consultant who examines you scans you with diagnostic ultrasound and, when a procedure is right, performs it in the same appointment — image-guided, under local anaesthetic, as day care.

## Key facts

- Address: 3rd Floor, KKR Commercial Complex, Kukatpally Y Junction, Moosapet Road, Kukatpally, Hyderabad, Telangana 500072, India
- Landmark: Above the Max showroom at Kukatpally Y Junction, on Moosapet Road — a few minutes from the KPHB and Moosapet metro stations.
- Phone (appointments): +91 77880 91092; also +91 95536 04226. WhatsApp: +91 77880 91092
- Email: info@halcyonpainfree.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9 am – 6 pm. Closed on Sunday.
- Map: https://maps.google.com/?cid=14254788734567695869
- Doctors: Dr. Dasyam Pallavi (Director; MBBS, DA, CIPS, FIAPM) and Dr. PSS Kiran (Director; MBBS, MD Radiodiagnosis, Fellowship in Pain Management)
- How it works: the consultant who examines you scans you with diagnostic ultrasound and, if a procedure is right, performs it in the same appointment. Procedures are image-guided, under local anaesthetic, as day care — no general anaesthesia and no admission; most people are home within about two hours.
- Non-surgical: the one case where a replacement is still advised is advanced grade 4 knee arthritis with deformity.
- Costs are given at consultation, before anything is booked.

## Pain conditions treated

- [Knee Pain Treatment in Hyderabad](https://halcyonpainfree.com/knee-pain-treatment/): Non-surgical knee pain treatment in Kukatpally, Hyderabad: cooled RF, regenerative injections or prolotherapy under ultrasound, home the same day.
- [Low Back Pain Treatment in Hyderabad](https://halcyonpainfree.com/low-back-pain-treatment/): Non-surgical low back pain treatment in Kukatpally, Hyderabad. A diagnostic block finds the source first, then targeted day-care treatment follows.
- [Neck Pain Treatment in Hyderabad](https://halcyonpainfree.com/neck-pain-treatment/): Non-surgical neck pain treatment in Kukatpally, Hyderabad. A medial branch block finds the painful joint; cervical facet RF treats it, as day care.
- [Shoulder Pain Treatment in Hyderabad](https://halcyonpainfree.com/shoulder-pain/): Frozen shoulder and rotator cuff pain treated without surgery in Kukatpally, Hyderabad: nerve block, hydrodilatation or regenerative injection.
- [Sciatica Treatment in Hyderabad](https://halcyonpainfree.com/sciatica/): Non-surgical sciatica treatment in Kukatpally, Hyderabad: an image-guided transforaminal or epidural injection aimed at the irritated nerve root.
- [Slipped Disc Treatment in Hyderabad](https://halcyonpainfree.com/slipped-disc-treatment/): Slipped disc treated without surgery in Kukatpally, Hyderabad: an image-guided epidural injection at the level a scan and block confirm, as day care.
- [Hip Pain Treatment in Hyderabad](https://halcyonpainfree.com/the-best-hip-pain-treatment-in-hyderabad/): Non-surgical hip pain treatment in Kukatpally, Hyderabad: bursitis, labral tears and hip arthritis scanned and treated by image-guided injection, same day.
- [Sports Injury Treatment in Hyderabad](https://halcyonpainfree.com/sports-injuries-treatment/): Non-surgical sports injury treatment in Kukatpally, Hyderabad: tendon, ligament and overuse injuries scanned, graded and treated to heal, not just quieten.
- [Trigeminal Neuralgia Treatment in Hyderabad](https://halcyonpainfree.com/trigeminal-neuralgia-treatment/): Non-surgical trigeminal neuralgia treatment in Kukatpally, Hyderabad: when medicine stops working, image-guided radiofrequency of the affected branch.
- [Elbow, Hand & Wrist Pain Treatment in Hyderabad](https://halcyonpainfree.com/advanced-elbow-hand-and-wrist-pain-treatment/): Non-surgical tennis elbow, carpal tunnel and de Quervain’s treatment in Kukatpally, Hyderabad: nerve hydrodissection or regenerative injection, same day.
- [Foot & Ankle Pain Treatment in Hyderabad](https://halcyonpainfree.com/foot-ankle-pain-treatment/): Non-surgical plantar fasciitis and Achilles pain treatment in Kukatpally, Hyderabad: prolotherapy or regenerative injection under ultrasound, as day care.
- [Cervical Spondylosis Treatment in Hyderabad](https://halcyonpainfree.com/cervical-spondylosis-treatment/): Non-surgical cervical spondylosis treatment in Kukatpally, Hyderabad: a medial branch block proves the source, then cervical facet RF, as day care.

## Treatments

- [Regenerative Medicine in Hyderabad](https://halcyonpainfree.com/regenerative-medicine/): Growth factor concentrate from your own blood, placed under ultrasound at Halcyon, Kukatpally. Non-surgical day care for worn or torn tendons and joints.
- [Radiofrequency Ablation in Hyderabad](https://halcyonpainfree.com/radiofrequency-ablations/): Radiofrequency ablation at Halcyon, Kukatpally: COOLIEF cooled RF for knee pain, block-first RF for neck and back. Non-surgical day care, local anaesthetic.
- [Prolotherapy Injections in Hyderabad](https://halcyonpainfree.com/prolotherapy/): Prolotherapy at Halcyon, Kukatpally: ultrasound-guided injections to restart repair in slack ligaments and tendons. Non-surgical day care, minimal downtime.
- [Nerve Hydrodissection & Nerve Blocks, Hyderabad](https://halcyonpainfree.com/non-surgical-nerve-hydrodissection-nerve-blocks/): Ultrasound-guided nerve hydrodissection and nerve blocks at Halcyon, Kukatpally, to free trapped nerves and find pain sources. Non-surgical, day care.
